name: Zach 3D Films
description: A 3D cartoon what-if explainer in three.js: procedural people and props, a blue studio sky, slow-motion impacts, a red force ripple and 1 to 3 word captions. Hermes makes it with /zach-d-films (alias /zach-3d-films).

cautions: Research only: a Hermes render is never published.
Hermes renders with the claude-animation-skills skill installed there; record what it used.
The format: an "If you..." hook, a misconception, a "But" twist, building examples, the mechanism and a payoff; check the facts.
Slow motion on the impact, a short shake, sparks, bloom; the red ripple shows force spreading; quick cuts on caption beats, one dip to black on the "But" turn.
Not affiliated with Zack D. Films; captions white, bold, 1 to 3 words.

curation.notes: Evidence for trial of a hermes pack (there is no Hermes in CI, so no CI render exists or is claimed). The skill is in the source repository at the pinned commit and the owner reports it works in Hermes. Every portal run of this pack is a research trial, never published.

hermes.input: A full project, not a quick spec. The run's skill brief (brief.text) is the project brief Hermes wrote from the approved script: the voiceover text (the run's approved narration script, one sentence per entry for script.json), the shot list (a shot every 2 to 4 s (8 to 10 for 30 s), cutting on caption beats, the mechanism shot longest) and the script order (hook, belief, the "But" turn, examples, payoff). The run has no voice stage: record the voiceover from that narration text with the free Kokoro voice the skill uses (stick-figure engine/tools/tts_kokoro.py), then words.py and captions.py for the caption timing, and time the shots, captions and sound to it as the skill does. Name the voice backend you used in the reply's voice field. Keep the skill's style rules.
hermes.output: A finished reel (1080x1920 H.264 MP4, 30 fps) with the voice the skill recorded from the run's narration script and the skill's captions and sound, published under /clip/ on the media host. It is a reel the studio then QCs (qc-video) and the owner scores on Review; it is never published.
